text:
I read all 9 tracked files. The basics are sound: canonical URLs, a sitemap, `lang="en"`, noindex on the account page, and a robots.txt that matches your policy for the AI crawlers it names. The main gaps are missing structured data, thin page content, and an incomplete training-crawler block.

## Higher impact

1. **No structured data anywhere.**
   - `app/layout.tsx` (whole file) and `app/visit/page.tsx:1-5` have no JSON-LD.
   - Add `Organization` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in `app/layout.tsx`.
   - Add `LocalBusiness` in `app/visit/page.tsx` with address, `openingHoursSpecification` and geo coordinates.
   - Add `Product` or `ItemList` in `app/varieties/page.tsx`.
   - Render each as `<script type="application/ld+json">`.

2. **Page content is too thin to cite.**
   - `app/page.tsx:4-5`, `app/varieties/page.tsx:4-5` and `app/visit/page.tsx:4-5` each hold one sentence.
   - The varieties page says "over forty varieties" but names only two. List every variety, each with its own heading and attributes such as flavour, use and harvest month. Link each one to its own page.
   - The visit page gives no address, no directions, no exact hours (only "Thursday to Sunday, April to October") and no contact details. State these as plain text, because that is what AI answers pull from.
   - The home page should say what you sell, how to buy it, delivery areas and prices.

3. **The training-crawler block is incomplete.**
   - `public/robots.txt:6-10` blocks only GPTBot and ClaudeBot, but `geo.config.json:5` says all training crawlers should be blocked.
   - Add `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `anthropic-ai`, `Meta-ExternalAgent` and `Bytespider`.
   - Search and retrieval agents (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot) fall under `User-agent: *` at `public/robots.txt:1-2`, which allows them. That matches your policy.
   - Consider naming them explicitly so the intent survives later edits.

4. **There are no site-wide metadata defaults.**
   - `app/layout.tsx:1` sets only `metadataBase`.
   - Add a `title` template and default, plus a default `description`.
   - Add `openGraph` (site name, locale, image) and `twitter` cards. No page has them (`app/page.tsx:1`, `app/varieties/page.tsx:1`, `app/visit/page.tsx:1`).
   - Add a favicon.

## Lower impact

5. **Descriptions are short.**
   - `app/visit/page.tsx:1` has "Opening times and directions." and `app/varieties/page.tsx:1` is similar.
   - Write 120–160 characters that include a keyword and a specific detail, such as the county or opening days.

6. **The sitemap has no `<lastmod>`.**
   - `public/sitemap.xml:3-5` is hand-maintained and will drift as pages are added.
   - Move to `app/sitemap.ts` so it is generated with `lastModified`.

7. **The account page is both disallowed and noindex.**
   - `public/robots.txt:3` (`Disallow: /account`) stops crawlers from fetching the page, so they never see the `noindex` at `app/account/page.tsx:1`.
   - The URL can still be listed without a snippet. Pick one approach. Keeping only the `noindex` and removing the Disallow is the most reliable. Keeping the Disallow is also acceptable, because the page has no content worth indexing.

8. **The nav uses plain `<a>` tags.**
   - `app/layout.tsx:7` should use `next/link` for client-side navigation and prefetching. This affects performance rather than crawling.

9. **Optional: add `public/llms.txt`.**
   - A short summary of the site with links to the key pages. Support among AI search products is inconsistent, so treat it as optional.

10. **`geo.config.json` has no effect that I can see.**
    - Nothing in the repo reads it (`package.json:4-5` has only dev and build scripts), so it is documentation only.
    - Either generate `robots.txt` from it or add a check so the two files can't drift apart. Item 3 is already a case of them disagreeing.

## Not a problem
`data-nosnippet` on the cookie notice (`app/layout.tsx:10`) is appropriate. It keeps boilerplate out of snippets.

I haven't changed anything. I can implement items 1–4 and 6 if you'd like.
